history.content: Dealership made me the secondary owner to my own car

I recommend to start contacting your local news stations, local authorities, and do everything to talk to the dealership owner. You can try to return the vehicle and get your money back from the dealership.
what if the dealership does not give me back the money?

If the dealership refuses to give you your money back, you can consider getting in touch with a lawyer to explore legal options. If hiring a lawyer is too expensive, you can also try getting in touch with local media to have them run a story about your situation. If you can state it is illegal, the dealership is likely refund you the money. However, I think the dealership will refund your money.
do you think there is anything that I need to be careful when I am dealing money issue with the dealership?
Yes, 1). Don't take the car back! 2). Bring all your receipts, etc and don't hand over the keys until you have the check in hand.
if I go to another dealership, should I pay in full case? or should I take out a loan?

You should buy your car with cash. 1). you can have discounts. 2). you will never be upside down on the car. 3). you can sell your car anytime you want. 4). you will not need to worry about loan interest, which will save you money.  Additionally, borrowing the money and paying for it over time makes it psychologically easier to over spend on transportation.
